acceptanceCriteria: A spec defines a versioned, strict snapshot format bound to base/head SHAs and the CEM digest, produced by a pure export function; the diff bytes come from the bound commits, never from the live worktree.
Any viewer is static, offline and pinned by content hash, with no network, account or hosted service, consistent with invariant 7 and decision 0081.
Chapters reuse V1-0408 ordering and cite the evidence that placed each hunk; a snapshot whose binding fails verification is refused, not rendered.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Idea from reviewing backnotprop/plannotator ADR 006/007 (2026-10-06): guided reviews are exported as one small self-contained HTML file holding a strictly versioned JSON snapshot (guide, the exact diff captured when the review job starts rather than at export, provenance), rendered by a pinned, content-hashed viewer; export is a pure function. That matches Corvint invariant 1 (evidence pinned to immutable Git content). Corvint's reviewer report and CEM are already immutable, but there is no single portable artifact a human reviewer can open offline, and no importance-ordered, chaptered walkthrough with per-chapter reviewed state. Ordering work already exists as V1-0408 (order review by AI-authored, unwitnessed hunks); this ticket is the export and walkthrough format.
title: Portable immutable review snapshot: one self-contained file binding the diff, CEM, reviewer report and a chaptered walkthrough
